# Element Home Remodeling

> Oak wood staircase specialists and general home remodeling contractor serving Ocala, Orlando, Gainesville and the surrounding Central Florida area. Stairs (wood, glass, metal, cable) plus kitchen, bathroom, custom closets, carpentry and painting.

## Company
- Name: Element Home Remodeling (also referred to as EHR Remodeling)
- Flagship service: Oak Wood Staircase
- Service area: Ocala, Orlando, Gainesville and surrounding Central Florida
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- Phone: (954) 826-5786 (Leonardo Haluche — Owner), (954) 696-4859 (Bianca Moreira — Estimates & Scheduling), (954) 588-4403 (Jader Alencar — Owner)
- Office: 1210 SW First Way, Deerfield Beach, FL 33441 (office and workshop; jobs are done at the customer's home in the service area)
- Website: https://ehrremodeling.com

## Services
- Oak Wood Staircase — our signature service, solid oak stairs built and finished on site.
- Stair Remodeling — replacing carpet, treads, risers and dated balustrades with new materials.
- Custom Stairs — staircases in wood, glass, metal or cable, designed around the home.
- Metal Railings — fabricated and powder-coated steel balustrades, modern or traditional.
- Glass Railings — frameless low-iron tempered glass on stainless standoffs.
- Custom Handrails — hand-shaped continuous wood and metal handrails.
- Kitchen Remodeling — full and partial kitchen remodels, including cabinetry, countertops and islands, backsplash and tile, layout changes, lighting and finishes.
- Bathroom Remodeling — from a full gut to a refresh, including showers and tubs, tile, vanities, fixtures, lighting and finishes.
- Carpentry — custom carpentry and trim work.
- Interior Painting — interior painting and stain work.
- Custom Closets — custom closet built-ins designed around the home, including shelving, drawers, hanging space, shoe and accessory storage, doors, mirrors and lighting.

## Frequently asked questions (stair remodeling)
- Do you build custom staircases in Ocala, FL? Yes — Ocala is one of our core service areas, alongside Orlando and Gainesville.
- How long does a stair remodel take? Most remodels (new treads, risers, railings) run 1–2 weeks; a full custom oak staircase built from the subfloor up takes longer.
- What railing materials are offered? Solid oak, frameless glass, powder-coated black metal, or cable railing.
- Can they remodel a carpeted staircase? Yes — replacing worn carpet with solid oak treads/risers and updating the balustrade is one of the most requested projects.
- How much does a new staircase cost? Depends on size, materials and scope (remodel vs. full rebuild); estimates are free.

## Frequently asked questions (kitchen remodeling)
- How long does a kitchen remodel take? It depends on the size of the kitchen, the scope of the work and when materials are available. The timeline for each project is confirmed in writing before work starts.
- Do I need a permit to remodel my kitchen? It depends on the work. Changes to plumbing, electrical, gas lines or walls commonly require a permit, while cosmetic updates often do not. Requirements vary by city and county.
- Can I use my kitchen during the remodel? A smaller update may allow partial use of the room. With a full remodel, plan on the kitchen being out of service for much of the project.
- Do you help choose materials and finishes? Yes. Homeowners can bring their own ideas or start from scratch, and the team explains how each option fits their style, budget and use of the kitchen.
- What cities do you serve? Ocala, Orlando, Gainesville and the surrounding areas of Central Florida.

## Frequently asked questions (bathroom remodeling)
- How long does a bathroom remodel take? It depends on the size of the room, the scope of the work and when materials are available. The timeline for each project is confirmed in writing before work starts.
- Do I need a permit to remodel my bathroom? It depends on the work. Moving plumbing, changing electrical or altering walls commonly requires a permit, while cosmetic updates often do not. Requirements vary by city and county.
- Can I use my bathroom during the remodel? In most remodels, plan on the bathroom being out of service while the main work is underway. Homeowners with only one bathroom should mention it at the estimate.
- Do you help choose tile, fixtures and finishes? Yes. Homeowners can bring their own ideas or start from scratch, and the team explains how each option fits their style, budget and use of the room.
- What cities do you serve? Ocala, Orlando, Gainesville and the surrounding areas of Central Florida.

## Frequently asked questions (custom closets)
- How long does a custom closet project take? It depends on the size of the closet, the design and when materials are available. The timeline for each project is confirmed in writing before work starts.
- Do I need a permit for a custom closet? Built-in shelving and storage often do not need one, but moving walls or adding electrical work may. Requirements vary by city and county.
- Do I need to empty my closet before installation? Yes, the space needs to be clear so the team can work safely and keep belongings protected.
- Do you help choose the layout and finishes? Yes. Homeowners can bring their own ideas or start from scratch, and the team explains how shelving, drawers, hanging space and finishes fit their style, budget and storage needs.
- What cities do you serve? Ocala, Orlando, Gainesville and the surrounding areas of Central Florida.
